description: For this musical multiplayer puzzle game, I was one of two designers.

Throughout the first three weeks we spent a considerable amount of time arguing about the positioning of game elements (camera, player, walls, ...). I managed to reduce the decision-making time from several days to a single day by finding a compromise through a comparison of several minimal in-engine prototypes.

When our main designer became unavailable throughout the last three weeks, I stepped in. I created 15 levels with enough variety that we could confidently select the strongest 6 to match our six musical layers.
